name: sunsky_online-mcp
description: Sunsky Online (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, quote_shipping, create_order, g

platform_mcp_sunsky_online_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SUNSKY_ONLINE_KEY
platform_mcp_sunsky_online_key.description: SUNSKY Open API key, issued by your SUNSKY sales manager (https://doc.sunsky-online.com/).

platform_mcp_sunsky_online_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SUNSKY_ONLINE_SECRET
platform_mcp_sunsky_online_secret.description: SUNSKY Open API secret issued with the key; signs every call (MD5 of the parameter values sorted by name, then '@' + secret) and is never sent.

platform_mcp_sunsky_online_language.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SUNSKY_ONLINE_LANGUAGE
platform_mcp_sunsky_online_language.description: Product text language code (Appendix E), e.g. en, fr, de, es, it, zh_CN; default en.

tools.name: me
tools.description: order!getBalance.do: your prepaid SUNSKY balance ({result: 'success', data: '1200.00'}); NO_PERMISSION_DUE_TO_SIGNATURE means the key/secret pair is wrong.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: product!search.do lists SUNSKY products (40 per page by default, max 100) filtered by `category` (a SUNSKY categoryId from category!getChildren.do, subcategories included). The API has NO keyword search, so `query` is ignored. `id` is the item # (itemNo) used by get_product, quote_shipping and create_order; prices are USD strings; priceList (quantity tiers), modelList and specs are in `raw`.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: product!detail.do by item # (itemNo): full product with priceList tiers, modelList, dimensions, packing, battery flag, specs (paramsTable) in `raw`. Prices are USD.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: order!getPricesAndFreights.do. `country` must be SUNSKY's numeric countryId (from order!getCountries.do, e.g. 41 = U.S.A.), not an ISO code; `product_id` is the item # (itemNo); always pass `quantity`. Each option's `id` is the shippingWayId that create_order takes as shipping_option; the item prices (priceList) are in `raw`.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: order!createOrder.do. `items`: up to 10 rows [{itemNo, qty, remark?}]; `shipping_address` in SUNSKY form {countryId (numeric, order!getCountries.do), state (state code), city, address, address2?, postcode, receiver, telephone?, email?, company?, shipment: 'drop' (dropshipping) | 'wholesale'} plus optional order-level siteNumber (your reference, ≤32 chars), vatNumber, eoriNumber, iossNumber, coupon; `shipping_option` is the shippingWayId from quote_shipping. The order is created UNPAID (useBalanceOnly defaults to false); `id` is the SUNSKY order number.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: order!getOrderDetails.do by SUNSKY order number. `status` is the numeric order status of Appendix C (https://doc.sunsky-online.com/appendixes-8295235m0); detailList (items) and deliveryAddress are in `raw`.

tools.name: track
tools.description: SUNSKY has no tracking-events API: this reads the order's trackingNumber, shipping way and its tracking query URL (append the number, e.g. https://t.17track.net/en#nums=) from order!getOrderDetails.do; `status` is the Appendix C order status.
